dialog: User: Hi, my name is Tedward and I recently purchased the Champion Traps and Targets .22 Bullet Trap (Rimfire Only). I have been really happy with it. I shoot out my second story window to about 50 yards away into this trap. It does what it says and has held up to about 500 rounds so far without any significant wear. I also suggest using a cardboard backer to help with paper curls since it only attaches at the top.

Agent: Hello, Tedward! I'm glad to hear that you're happy with the Champion Traps and Targets .22 Bullet Trap. It's a great choice for rimfire shooting. However, I have a review for the Pigeon Hangers - 25 Pack that you might be interested in. One customer mentioned that they don't work well with standard clay pigeons as they don't hold them securely. So, if you're considering pigeon hangers, you might want to keep this in mind.
User: Thanks for the information. Can you recommend something similar to the Champion Traps and Targets .22 Bullet Trap?
